key_points.point: The company transfers its entire 66% stake in 中软系统 to related party 信安院 (a wholly-owned subsidiary of actual controller 中国电子) for 46,330.49 万元 (4.63 亿元), priced on the state-filed net-asset appraisal and negotiated; the deal takes effect only upon the company's shareholders' meeting approval, and related directors 谌志华, 赵贵武 and 张尼 recused from the board vote

Two scopes coexist: the appraisal runs on the parent scope (book net assets 50,412.52 万元, appraised 70,197.71 万元; 46,330.49 = 70,197.71×66%), while the disclosed 40.02% premium is against the consolidated-scope book value 33,088.34 万元 (premium 13,242.15 万元) — the scopes must not be conflated; the base date 2023-12-31 is nearly a year before the signing date 2024-12-06, during which the target kept losing money: latest (2024-11-30, unaudited) attributable equity 27,392.42 万元 and 2024 Jan-Nov attributable net profit -22,980.73 万元

Three instalments: a first payment of 11,175.46 万元 within three days of effectiveness; by 2025-03-31 the second instalment = (46,330.49 万元 + transition-period P&L × 66%) × 51% − 11,175.46 万元; by 2025-06-15 the balance = (46,330.49 万元 + transition-period P&L × 66%) × 49% — both later instalments contain the undisclosed transition-period P&L variable
中软系统's registered capital is 31,691.1764 万元; '对应中软系统注册资本20,916.1764万元' is the registered-capital portion corresponding to the 66% stake (=31,691.1764×66%) — two different calibers not to be swapped

Transition-period P&L of the target stake (including declared but undistributed dividends) is borne and enjoyed by Party B (中国软件, the seller), and belongs to Party A (信安院) after the closing date; the agreement's effective date is the closing date, with effectiveness requiring both signatures, Party A's shareholder consent and Party B's shareholders' meeting approval

absence_points.question: Can the second instalment's exact amount be determined now
absence_points.expected: No: the second-instalment formula contains 'target transition-period P&L × 66%', and the transition-period P&L is undisclosed and determinable only at closing; computing a fixed value by dropping that term (46,330.49×51%−11,175.46=12,453.09 万元) has no basis in the announcement — with the target still loss-making, the real second instalment is likely below that figure

notes: Dual scope is the crux: the appraisal chain is parent-scope (50,412.52→70,197.71) while the disclosed 40.02% premium is against the consolidated 33,088.34 — a parent-scope recomputation (≈39.25%) also 'looks right', so the announcement's scope must be identified. The registered-capital pair (20,916.1764 portion vs 31,691.1764 total) is the same disease. A1 crux: the second-instalment formula carries the undisclosed transition-period P&L; 12,453.09 万元 is the tempting variable-dropping arithmetic. The stale base date plus Jan-Nov losses of -22,980.73 万元 is the analytical tension, but asserting 'the final consideration will be below 4.63 亿' is equally unsupported. K5 direction: transition P&L goes to the seller until closing — unlike MB-028's 50:50 phase split.
trap_note: Three traps: (1) fixing the second instalment at 12,453.09 万元 (fabricating a value for a missing quantity); (2) premium-scope mismatch (40.02% consolidated vs ≈39.25% parent — both 'look right'); (3) treating the 20,916.1764 registered-capital portion as the total (or vice versa).
